{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate within each customer_segment, then average across segments
# This is a stratified estimate of the effect
conversion_by_segment_channel = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
segment_differences = conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] - conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search']

# Compute the overall difference using the stratified method (weighted by segment size)
segment_sizes = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
stratified_difference = (segment_differences * segment_sizes).sum()

# Print the results
print("Conversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates within each segment (email - paid_search):")
print(segment_differences)
print("\nStratified difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search):")
print(stratified_difference)"}
